nodes.label: publish-tauri
nodes.rationale: Matrix CI job that builds and publishes SSHyar releases on tag push (v*) for Windows and Linux via tauri-apps/tauri-action.

nodes.label: ubuntu-24.04
nodes.rationale: Linux release runner; AppImage/deb built on Ubuntu 24.04 to match WebKitGTK 4.1 desktop requirement.

nodes.label: Interactive sudo via terminal inject
nodes.rationale: Privileged Nginx/systemd actions inject into the SSH terminal for interactive sudo instead of requiring passwordless sudo on the server.

nodes.label: SSHyar Brand Icon (terminal prompt + padlock on teal)
nodes.norm_label: sshyar brand icon (terminal prompt + padlock on teal)
nodes.rationale: Visual identity: > prompt for terminal + padlock for vault/security
